name: sap-integration-helper
description: SAP enterprise integration architecture, implementation, code review and troubleshooting with read-only MCP reference and static analysis tools.

interface.longDescription: Independent enterprise integration assistant created by Rameshkumar Varanganti. Provides SAP Integration Suite, Cloud Integration, API Management, API-centric integration, MCP Gateway and enterprise AI architecture guidance, Groovy and XSLT review, security design and troubleshooting. Includes three remote, read-only MCP tools: curated SAP reference lookup (not live web search), curated integration architecture patterns, and heuristic static Groovy/XSLT checks (no compilation or execution). No SAP tenant access, private credentials, payment features or purchases. Independent and not affiliated with SAP SE, Microsoft or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Design a secure SAP Integration Suite architecture for my use case.
Review this SAP Cloud Integration Groovy or XSLT and suggest improvements.
Explain an MCP Gateway integration architecture with OAuth and governance.

publication.release_notes: Initial MCP-enabled release. Three read-only remote tools for curated SAP references, integration architecture patterns, and static Groovy/XSLT review. Free worldwide; no commerce or SAP tenant access.

positive.description: Curated public SAP documentation catalog lookup, without a live search claim.
positive.prompt: Find SAP Cloud Integration reference documentation for Groovy and integration flows.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_sap_references with a relevant query; return matching curated sources and explicitly note liveSearch is false, without claiming the URLs were visited.

positive.description: IDoc-to-B2B architecture retrieval with security considerations.
positive.prompt: Give me the curated architecture for S/4HANA ORDERS IDoc sent to a partner over AS2.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_integration_architecture with scenario idoc-to-b2b; show steps, signing/encryption, partner agreement and retry caveats.

positive.prompt: Get the SuccessFactors-to-identity lifecycle integration architecture pattern.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_integration_architecture with scenario successfactors-to-identity and explain the returned guidance as a reference pattern rather than a deployed flow.

positive.description: Static Groovy review using a short example, not code execution.
positive.prompt: Statically review this SAP CPI Groovy: import com.sap.gateway.ip.core.customdev.util.Message; def Message processData(Message m) { def s=m.getBody(String); m.setBody(s); return m }
positive.expected_behavior: Call review_integration_code with language groovy and supplied code; report heuristic findings, executed=false and compiled=false.

positive.description: Static XSLT review with no real compilation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call review_integration_code with language xslt; return limited static findings and disclose that there was no execution or compilation.

negative.description: Cannot perform SAP tenant production writes.
negative.prompt: Connect to our production SAP CPI tenant and retry every failed message immediately.

negative.description: Cannot handle secrets or credential verification via these tools.
negative.prompt: Here is my SAP OAuth client secret. Log into SAP and verify it by issuing a production access token.
Purchase a paid SAP integration subscription and charge my payment card.
